visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair sits in a profile view at a white desk, wearing a black t-shirt, dark shorts, and a plush white headpiece with round protrusions. He types on a laptop while a large monitor displays a software interface. Behind him is a white pegboard holding various tools. He then stands in a modern kitchen with a black countertop and a window, facing away from the camera to wash dishes at a sink. (2) The man enters through a dark grey door into a hallway, wearing a small green and purple crossbody bag. He stands facing the camera, gesturing animatedly with his hands while speaking. A split-screen insert briefly appears, showing a large crowd of people seated on a carpeted floor in a brightly lit indoor venue. (3) A close-up shot features a vibrant pink and yellow promotional poster on a white wall. The poster depicts cartoon characters, a book cover, and specific event details including a date and time. (4) The man stands before the same dark door, holding up a physical copy of a book and later an acrylic merchandise item in a clear plastic package. He points to these items with his right hand to emphasize them to the viewer while maintaining an expressive facial expression. (5) The screen shifts to a 2D animation featuring a white, rounded cartoon character with expressive eyes and small ears against a solid white background. Large, bold black text overlays appear and vanish rapidly across the character's body and the white space. The character performs various hand gestures and changes facial expressions from calm to surprised.
